capabilities: chat with vault notes and documents in a sidebar
run keyword and meaning-based (RAG) search over the vault
extract text from PDF, EPUB, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX and other formats
cite sources with links to paths, headings, lines, or PDF pages
connect AI providers including ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Ollama, and MCP servers
extras: Free and open source (MIT), desktop only, requires Obsidian 1.11.4 or later; the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README is bilingual (English and Korean) and covers data-privacy choices, processing limits, and manual installation.
problem: Obsidian's search is keyword-based and cannot answer questions, read PDFs or office documents directly, or link answers back to their sources.

relations.evidence: Connect ChatGPT browser sign-in, Google Gemini, OpenCode, Claude, Ollama, OpenRouter, an OpenAI API key, or a custom endpoint
Ollama uses its native API; change the endpoint URL to use a local server or Ollama Cloud.
enable Answers informed by installed plugins, connect Context7 MCP, and name an active plugin in your question
Local stdio uses Claude Desktop's command, optional args, and string env fields.

requires.name: AI provider account (e.g. ChatGPT or Google)
API key for OpenAI, OpenRouter, OpenCode, or custom endpoints

summary: AI chat assistant that answers questions from vault notes and documents with citations, using ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Ollama, or other providers.
